claims.claim: Missing records, non-response, boundary choices and sampling affect graph statistics including degree, clustering and connected components.

claims.claim: Random missing nodes distort centrality and topology measurements to differing degrees.
claims.locator: Smith and Moody (2013), structural effects of network sampling coverage I

claims.claim: Computing professionals should respect privacy and only access data with appropriate authorization.
